acceptance: the executed conversion authority is verified by the raw SHA-256 of its bytes
the committed source authority is verified independently from execution.committed_authority_sha256 inside that file
neither digest can stand in for the other and swapping them is rejected
exact main, workflow run id and attempt recorded inside the executed file are bound
raw-file verification is preserved and never replaced by the recorded field
the committed digest equals the canonical-JSON digest of the in-repository conversion authority
the top-level authority_sha256 is recomputed by the accepted algorithm
forbidden_capabilities: model, GGUF, toolchain, conversion provenance or source revision changes
SSH host-key pinning, credential handling or runtime limits changes
evidence schema, retention or maturity status changes
Gateway, UI, routing, feature-flag, model-admission or deployment changes
